rv.q: If you want to grab one of the few remaining tickets left for this show you should ignore my rating and go along with an open mind.
White Rabbit Red Rabbit is a wildly entertaining and still very current production, wholly unique and well worth seeing.
All in all, White Rabbit Red Rabbit is a deeply moving and, at times, thrilling theatrical experiment.

Where Soleimanpour's text really shines is its place at the heart of in-the-round West End space @sohoplace – the cauldron-shaped auditorium allows the audience to feel complicit, communally engaged and unavoidably linked to Mohammed's antics.
White Rabbit Red Rabbit struggles to convincingly bridge the gap between its commentary on censorship and its interrogation of the nature of performance.
This simplicity paired with the intimate venue of the Duchess Theatre creates the perfect playful environment for this bold theatrical experience.

cn.t: Critics praise this daring theatrical experiment where a different unprepared actor performs each night, calling it engaging, audacious, and poignant, with audiences feeling complicit in the bewildering mystery.

lo.inst: Enter draw via TodayTix app only. Performances only on occasional Mondays.
